name: Parisian Café During a Riot
description: A woman in sunglasses and a black coat sips an espresso at a Paris café terrace, completely unbothered. Behind her, riot police in helmets form a line, red smoke flares billow between Haussmann buildings, and fires burn behind metal barricades on the wet pavement.
usage: Someone staying calm, comfortable or oblivious while everything around them falls apart. Usually captioned above as "X while Y", where X is the unbothered one and Y is the chaos.

source.author: @RetentionAdam
source.example: Bootstrapped founders while OpenAI and Anthropic make it impossible to sell or take secondary.
